author: FirstSintax
body:
Heyo guys

I've seen the new craze of +1's from people liking a post or discussion. Web devs, if you can, please add a button where we can easily like a comment. 

P.s. Google+ might be mad.

+1 if you would like to see the button XD.

replies.author: Arachadonic
replies.body:
Pros: Cuts down on the +1 posts. Makes people feel good about themselves.
Cons: Can lead to accusations of "like farming". People fixate too much about getting "+1"s and it overwhelms their entire being and they get trapped in an endless vortex of needing and craving the almightly "+1"

I've been in forums where it exists and where it doesn't exist and I sort of like it how things are now without it. There are no fights over "like farming" and the bump topics can get from saying "+1" can help keep the topic up and therefore get more people to see it.
